summary.en: Simplify registered-Agent onboarding, shorten NPC turns, preserve peaceful-night facts and highlight public Seer claims with accessible table motion.
summary.zh: 简化已登记 Agent 接入、缩短 NPC 发言、保留平安夜公共事实，并突出预言家声明与可访问的圆桌动效。

reason: Player entry and conversation behavior changed; no private design assets or local runtime data are included.

compatibility.en: Existing saves remain readable. New public metadata is additive; missing old peaceful-night metadata is not fabricated. New model speech uses shorter limits.
compatibility.zh: 旧存档仍可读取。新增公共元数据，不虚构旧档缺失的平安夜事实；后续模型发言采用较短限制。
